contests.title: 1.a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: No registered/cast/null figures printed; grouping totals on pp. 4-5, cuocientes and proclamation on p. 6 (box). List 3's elected Humberto Arellano (1,054) is proclaimed although Hernán Miranda Perou has 1,080 as printed; the proclamation names Arellano. Candidate parties are from the proclamation.

contests.title: 2a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: No registered/cast/valid/null figures typed. A handwritten '15.359' under the table on p. 9 equals the sum of list totals; not recorded as valid. Lists 8, 11 and 12 show only dashes (recorded as 0). Proclamation on p. 10.

contests.title: 3a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: Accounting from the RESUMEN GENERAL on p. 12: Total de votantes 6.702, No votaron 1.212, inscritos 7.914; 'Votos viciados y en blanco' 31. Valid not printed (lists sum 6,671 = 6,702 - 31). Two lists are printed as 'Lista N°5' (Independiente and Conservador); the cuocientes on p. 13 call the Conservador list 'Lista 6' and print List 3's figure as 1.210 although the table gives 1.310 (whose preferences add to 1,310). Lista N°4 has no party printed.

contests.title: 4a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: Accounting from p. 15: votos viciados y en blanco 53; Total de votantes 18.583; No votaron 2.529; total inscritos 21.112. Valid not printed (lists sum 18,530). Lista 3 shows dashes only (0). Seats allotted under rules 5a/6a of art. 117 (list order), so elected candidates are not always the highest in preferences. Proclamation pp. 15-16.

contests.title: 5a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: Figures are the 'Totales escrutinio general definitivo' (pp. 19-20, Tribunal, 20 July 1937), which add the complementary election of 13 June 1937 in Longotoma 1a./2a. Extraordinaria and Petorca 2a. Extr./1a. Perm. (where the election was ordered repeated) to the rectified scrutiny of pp. 17-18. In the definitive table the no-preference votes are already merged into the first candidate (sin preferencia '-'), recorded as unassigned 0. The p. 19 heading says 'ELIGE 5 DIPUTADOS' but the index (p. 2) says 3 and three are proclaimed. p. 20 prints List 5's pre-complementary total as 2.943 although its rows (2.005 + 2.938) give 4.943 (p. 18 has 4.943). Registered 12.143 and 'Total de votantes' 10.913 are from p. 18 (original 7 March scrutiny, before annulment and the complementary election); no updated accounting is printed. Lista 1 (Democrático) 'Retirada'.

contests.title: 8a. Agrupacion Departamental
contests.notes: 'Viciados y en blanco' 94 (p. 41). No registered/cast/valid printed. Lista 1 'Retirada'. The cuocientes on p. 41 use 3.358 for List 2 and 8.187 for List 4, while the table totals (which their rows add to) are 3.355 and 8.190. List 3 prints a 'Sin preferencia' row with no figure.

contests.notes: 'Viciados' 80 (p. 43; recorded as invalid). No registered/cast/valid printed. Lista 1 'Retirada'. On p. 43 the scan cuts off the first letters of the List 5 and List 6 names; List 6 names are completed from the identical names in List 2 (p. 42) and the proclamation (p. 44); letters in [] are not visible ('[...]berto Peña y Lillo T.' first name unreadable). The same six candidates appear in both List 2 (Democrático) and List 6, as printed. Proclamation spells 'Rafael Irarrázaval Correa' / 'Sebastián Santandreu Herrera'.

contests.title: 10a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: Figures are the 'Escrutinio General' column of the definitive table (pp. 49-50, Tribunal, 14 June 1937), which adds the complementary election of 13 June 1937 (Paredones 1a./2a. Extr. and 1a. Perm., San Pedro de Alcántara 1a. Extr./1a. Perm., Lolol 1a. Perm.) to the rectified provisional scrutiny of pp. 45-46. Source error: Oscar Gajardo Villarroel is printed 1.745 in the Escrutinio General column although 1.627 + 128 = 1.755, and the list total 1.906 (= 1.778 + 128) needs 1.755; kept as printed. List 5 is 'Carlos Smith Tobar', 303 votes, no party in the provisional table (p. 46) but 'Carlos Amith Tobar', 307, Demócrata in the definitive one (p. 50); definitive kept. Ernesto Concha Díaz shows dashes throughout (null). No registered/cast/null figures printed. Elected parties from the provisional proclamation (p. 47); Gajardo's not printed. p. 48 is a misplaced page from another grouping (Tomé, Concepción, Talcahuano, Yumbel, Coronel).

contests.title: 11a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: 'Viciados' 29 (p. 52; recorded as invalid). No registered/cast/valid printed. Proclamation p. 53 gives no parties.

contests.title: 12a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: 'Viciados' 80 (p. 55; recorded as invalid). No registered/cast/valid printed. List 2's total (513) is partly blotted; read with 2 + 511. List 4 shows only dashes (votes null). The scan cuts the first letters of List 5's names on p. 55 (bracketed letters supplied from the proclamation). The proclamation (p. 56, dated 28 Abril 1937) gives List 1's seat to Alejandro Dussaillant L. 'que obtuvo la más alta votación', although the table prints Pedro Ortiz M. with 939 against Dussaillant's 828; recorded as proclaimed (under art. 117 the 1.477 no-preference votes accrue to the list's first candidate, Dussaillant).

contests.title: 13a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: 'En blanco' 5 (p. 57). No registered/cast/valid printed. List 3 and Jorge Santa María Cerveró show only dashes (null). Emiliano Bustos León (11 preferences) is proclaimed because the list's 2.069 no-preference votes are allotted to candidates in list order (art. 117). Proclamation p. 58 gives no parties.

contests.title: 14a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: No registered/cast/null figures printed. Lists 1-2, 6 and 8 do not appear (table starts at List 3). Lists 5, 7 and 9 show only dashes (null). Scan clips first letters of List 4/5 names on p. 59 (bracketed letters supplied from the proclamation p. 61 where available; 'Manuel' inferred from '[M]anuel' visible as 'lanuel'). Source inconsistency in List 10: no-preference printed 115 though its commune cells give 1 + 109 + 3 = 113; rows then add to 4.167 while the list total (and its column totals 1.819 + 1.110 + 1.236) is 4.165; kept as printed. Proclamation dated 21 Abril 1937.

contests.title: 15a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: Figures are the 'Escrutinio General' column of the definitive table (p. 64, Tribunal, June 1937), which adds the complementary election of 13 June 1937 in Quirihue, Ninhue and Cobquecura to the provisional scrutiny of p. 62 (which had annulled those communes' votes: provisional líquido L2 1.048, L3 477, L4 3.147, with all three seats to List 4 per p. 63). Final proclamation p. 65: List 4 two seats, List 2 one. p. 65 says Subercaseaux had 2.392 votes (the table gives 2.342 + 50 no-preference = 2.392). No registered/cast/null figures printed. List 1 only dashes (null).

contests.title: 16a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: No registered/cast/null figures printed. Dashes recorded as null. Miguel Opazo Letelier (54 preferences) is proclaimed by transfer of surpluses under art. 117 (p. 67). Proclamation gives no parties.

contests.title: 17a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: Cuadro de escrutinio general rectificado (Tribunal, 13 May 1937), pp. 68-70; p. 48 is a misplaced, lower-quality copy of p. 69. 'Viciados' 26 (p. 70; recorded as invalid). No registered/cast/valid printed. Lista 2 'Retirada'. Source error in List 8: Guillermo Alarcón Carrasco is printed 43 in the total column although his commune cells are 2 (Concepción) + 43 (Coronel) = 45; with 45 the rows add to the printed list total 2.879. Kept 43 as printed. Seats under rules 5a/6a of art. 117 (pp. 70-71), so some elected trail unelected candidates.

contests.title: 18a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: No registered/cast/null figures printed. List 2 absent from the table. List 6 only dashes (null). First letter of 'Oscar Cuadra Pacheco' clipped by the scan. Proclamation p. 73 gives no parties.

contests.title: 19a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: Figures are the 'Escrutinio General' column of the definitive table (pp. 74-75), which adds the complementary election of 13 June 1937 (1a. Perm. Quilaco and 1a. Perm. Nacimiento) to the provisional scrutiny. 'Viciados' 109 (recorded as invalid). No registered/cast/valid printed. Areas are not printed in this table; taken from the index (p. 3). 'Sin preferencia' rows are blank in the general column (no-preference votes appear already merged into the first candidate; the 1 no-preference vote of List 3's complementary election is included in Freeman's 2.101 = 1.819 + 281 + 1); unassigned null. The cuocientes on p. 75 use 5.315 for List 3 and print 5.024 as half of 11.048 (should be 5.524); seat allocation (4 + 2) is unaffected. List 4 only dashes (null). Final proclamation pp. 75-76 (20 June 1937): List 1 four seats, List 3 two (Freeman, Osorio). pp. 77-79 hold an earlier definitive table of 13 May 1937 (before the complementary election) with different figures - L1 11.165 (sin pref. 37; Smitmans 2.851, Cifuentes 1.190, Coloma Rojas 3.331, de la Jara 3.755), L2 2.595 (75; Matus 1.162, Pezoa 1.358, San Martín 0), L3 5.125 (38; Freeman 1.829, Zerón Daroch 876, Latapia 115, Osorio 2.267), L4 0, 'votos en blanco y viciados' 109 - and a proclamation giving L1 4, L3 1 (Osorio), L2 1 (Pezoa); superseded by pp. 74-76 and not used. The 'Total según cuadro escrutinio provisional' column of p. 74 does not match the 13 May table.

contests.title: 20a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: No registered/cast/null figures printed. Lista 3 (Socialista de Chile) 'Retirada'; List 2 only dashes (null). Scan clips the first letters of names in Lists 6-8 on p. 81; bracketed letters are inferred (Uribe's from the proclamation, p. 82; others are guesses where a single letter is missing, '[...]' where more is missing). Proclamation spells 'Humberto Parada Bergar'.

contests.title: 21a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: 'En blanco' 61 (p. 85). No registered/cast/valid printed. The cuocientes on p. 85 use 6.624 for List 5, 3.884 for List 7 and 1.571 for List 8, while the table totals (which their rows add to) are 6.654, 3.849 and 1.572; seat allocation unaffected. Proclamation p. 85.

contests.title: 22a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: Final figures are the 'Escrutinio General' column of the definitive table (pp. 90-92) that adds the complementary election of 13 June 1937 in secciones 3a. and 4a. of circunscripción Tringlo (Rio Bueno): Labbé +52 (List 2: 1.793 -> 1.845) and Luis Urrutia Ibañez +30 (List 8: 5.364 -> 5.394); other lists unchanged from the 13 May table (pp. 86-88), whose boxes are cited. List 9 does not appear in pp. 90-92 (taken from p. 88; the p. 92 cuocientes still list it at 1.272). The pp. 90-92 table labels List 1 'Movimiento Nacional Socialista' where pp. 86 says 'Independiente'. Seats (8:3, 3:2, 4:2, 2:1) are the same in both versions. No registered/cast/null figures printed. The cuocientes (p. 88) use 1.615 for List 7 although the table gives 1.627 (its rows add to 1.627); also list a '(Lista 3) -.-' column. Seats under art. 117 rules; Juan Osorio Gómez (387) elected in List 8 ahead of Becerra (1.041). Proclamation pp. 88-89. Alfonso Bórquez Andrade appears in both List 5 and List 6, as printed.

contests.title: 23a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: No registered/cast/null figures printed. Index (p. 3) gives 'Aysen (Provincia)'. Proclamation p. 95.

contests.title: 24a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental
contests.notes: No registered/cast/null figures printed. On p. 96 the figures of each list are typed one line above their labels (first figure line = 'Sin preferencia'); read by position. Proclamation p. 97.

contests.title: 25a. Agrupacion Departamental
contests.notes: Single-member grouping; the table lists candidates without list numbers or parties, so each candidate is recorded as its own list labelled with his name. 'En blanco' 27, 'Marcados' -, 'Total' 3.889 (recorded as cast). Source error: Manuel Chaparro Ruminot's grouping total is printed 1.350 but his department cells (92 + 1.132 + 106) give 1.330; with 1.330 the candidates plus blanks add to the printed 3.889. Kept 1.350 as printed. Proclamation (p. 98, 'Manuscrito con tinta', 21 Abril 1937) elects Efraín Ojeda Ojeda.

contests.title: 7a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental - 1 er. Distrito Electoral
contests.notes: Santiago 1st district (comuna Santiago), one column only. No registered/cast/null figures printed. Lists 5 (Demócrata Socialista) and 16 (Radical) printed as 'Retirada'. Cuocientes on p. 31 give List 2 as 4.112 while the table total (and its rows) give 4.111. 'Amador Paivoa' is so spelled in the table and 'Amador Paiva'/'Pairoa' in the proclamation (pp. 32-33). The proclamation calls this 'escrutinio provisional' although the table heading says definitive. Proclamation gives no parties. Seats by rules 5a/6a of art. 117, so some elected trail unelected candidates.

contests.title: 7a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental - 2 da. Distrito Electoral
areas: Santiago (13 comunas rurales del 2do. Distrito Electoral)
contests.notes: Santiago 2nd district (13 rural communes), single column. No registered/cast/null figures printed. The no-preference figure of List 21 (178) is on p. 34; its candidates and total on p. 35. Proclamation pp. 35-36 calls it 'escrutinio provisional'; no parties given.

contests.title: 7a. Agrupacion Electoral Departamental - 3 er. Distrito Electoral
contests.notes: Santiago 3rd district, communes Providencia, Las Condes, Ñuñoa, Puente Alto, Pirque, San José de Maipo, Cisterna, San Miguel, La Florida. No registered/cast/null figures printed. List 13's no-preference and first three candidates are on p. 37, Julio Pereira Larrain and its total on p. 38. Lista 17 (Radical) 'Retirada'; Lista 25 (Demócrata Soc.) lists candidates but its cells are blank (votes null). Proclamation (p. 39) says 'La Lista N°13 elige 5 Diputados' but names 3, and List 24 elects 2 (5 seats in all).

notes: Volume of the Dirección del Registro Electoral with the Tribunal Calificador scrutiny tables and proclamations for the 25 departmental groupings of the 7 March 1937 deputies election (index pp. 2-3; tables pp. 4-98). The election day (7 March 1937) is not printed anywhere in the volume, so day is null. The 7th grouping (Santiago) is printed as three separate electoral districts, each with its own table and seats, and is recorded as contests 71 (1st district, 18 seats), 72 (2nd district, 5) and 73 (3rd district, 5). Where the volume prints both a provisional/rectified table and a definitive one that adds a complementary election of 13 June 1937 (groupings 5, 10, 15, 19, 22), the definitive figures are used and the differences are explained in the contest notes. p. 48 is a misplaced duplicate of p. 69 (grouping 17). Most tables print no registered/cast/valid figures; only what is printed is recorded. Candidate parties come from the proclamations where given. No national totals are printed.
